## The question

[Lie subalgebras of $so(3)$ and complex Lie subalgebras of $sl(2,\mathbb{C})$.](https://math.stackexchange.com/questions/1130505/lie-subalgebras-of-so3-and-complex-lie-subalgebras-of-sl2-mathbbc), asked by [MathematicalPhysicist](https://math.stackexchange.com/users/13374/mathematicalphysicist) on Mathematics Stack Exchange (2015-02-02; [CC BY-SA 3.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/)):

> I am looking for a reference that:
> describes all Lie subalgebras of $so(3)$,and describes all complex Lie subalgebras of $sl(2,\mathbb{C})$.
>
> Does someone have appropriate references?
:::

I don't know if it answers these specific questions explicitly, but you can find all you need in Helgason's book *Differential Geometry, Lie Groups, and Symmetric Spaces.*
